title: 太陽能熱發電吸熱器設計
summary: 塔式電廠的吸熱器把幾十萬平方公尺鏡場反射來的陽光，用幾百到上千平方公尺的管排吸收，通量是鍋爐爐膛的好幾倍；它必須吸得多、漏得少，又不能讓管子過熱或疲勞開裂。課程以德國于利希的試驗塔為背景，定量分析所需的吸熱面積、熱效率、管壁的溫差與熱應力、鹽膜溫度、循環次數與塗層衰退的影響。
summaryEn: The receiver of a tower plant absorbs sunlight from hundreds of thousands of square metres of mirrors on a few hundred to a thousand square metres of tube panels, at several times the flux of a boiler furnace; it must absorb much and lose little without overheating tubes or cracking them by fatigue. Set against the experimental tower at Jülich in Germany, the course quantifies receiver area needed, thermal efficiency, temperature difference and thermal stress in tube walls, film temperature, cycle count and the effect of coating degradation.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 每平方公尺承受上千瓩的管子：吸熱面積、熱效率、管壁應力、鹽膜溫度與疲勞
v30FocusEn: Tubes taking a megawatt per square metre: receiver area, thermal efficiency, wall stress, film temperature and fatigue

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：太陽能熱發電吸熱器設計
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Solar Thermal Receiver Design
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鏡場面積與年發電量」與「吸熱面積與平均通量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Field aperture and annual energy" and "Receiver area and mean flux": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field aperture and annual energy" is correct?
options: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。
陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。
吸熱器做得越小越集中，效率就越高。
optionsEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust.
On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels.
The smaller and more concentrated a receiver, the more efficient it is.
quiz.explanation: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「鏡場面積與年發電量」如何決定「太陽能熱發電吸熱器設計」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Field aperture and annual energy” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Solar Thermal Receiver Design”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：熔鹽管式吸熱器的出口鹽溫約 565 °C
steps.observationEn: Project file: Outlet salt temperature of a molten-salt tube receiver is about 565 °C
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「鏡場面積與年發電量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Field aperture and annual energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 熔鹽管式吸熱器的出口鹽溫約 565 °C

quiz.question: 依「鏡場面積與年發電量」的模型 E = DNI·A·η_se，鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = DNI·A·η_se for "Field aperture and annual energy", which value is closest to the annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)?
options: 250 GWh
499 GWh
optionsEn: 250 GWh
499 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2600 kWh/m²、Ah = 1200000 m²、etase = 0.16，得 499 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2600 kWh/m², Ah = 1200000 m², etase = 0.16 the result is 499 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡場面積與年發電量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Field aperture and annual energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2600 kWh/m²、Ah = 1200000 m²、etase = 0.16，得 499 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 etase 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2600 kWh/m², Ah = 1200000 m², etase = 0.16 the result is 499 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise etase by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 549 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 549 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 499 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 etase 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 499 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in etase with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2600 kWh/m²、Ah = 1200000 m²、etase = 0.16，得 499 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2600 kWh/m², Ah = 1200000 m², etase = 0.16 the result is 499 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 549 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 549 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field aperture and annual energy"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
鏡子只要大致對準塔頂就可以，精度不重要。
以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Mirrors need only point roughly at the tower top; accuracy does not matter.
Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.
quiz.explanation: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Field aperture and annual energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
knowledge.textEn: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62862 太陽熱發電廠標準系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62862 series on solar thermal electric plants. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「鏡場面積與年發電量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field aperture and annual energy" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
吸熱器做得越小越集中，效率就越高。
optionsEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The smaller and more concentrated a receiver, the more efficient it is.
quiz.explanation: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡場面積與年發電量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Field aperture and annual energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「太陽能熱發電吸熱器設計」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Solar Thermal Receiver Design”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
knowledge.textEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表

quiz.question: 關於「吸熱面積與平均通量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Receiver area and mean flux" is correct?
options: 吸熱器做得越小越集中，效率就越高。
吸熱器把照到它的陽光全部變成了熱。
吸熱器要做多大？
optionsEn: The smaller and more concentrated a receiver, the more efficient it is.
A receiver turns all sunlight striking it into heat.
How large should a receiver be?
quiz.explanation: 吸熱器要做多大？ 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: How large should a receiver be? The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吸熱面積與平均通量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Receiver area and mean flux: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「吸熱面積與平均通量」如何決定「太陽能熱發電吸熱器設計」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Receiver area and mean flux” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Solar Thermal Receiver Design”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 吸熱器要做多大？它必須吸收的熱功率是由鏡場決定的；除以表面的平均通量，就得到所需的面積。通量取得高，吸熱器小、熱損少、成本低；但通量越高，管壁的溫度梯度與熱應力越大，管內的流體也越容易局部過熱。熔鹽吸熱器的尖峰通量通常限制在每平方公尺一千瓩上下，平均值約為尖峰的一半。液態鈉的導熱好得多，可以承受兩倍以上的通量；水蒸汽與空氣則差得多。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: How large should a receiver be? Thermal power it must absorb is set by the field, and dividing by mean surface flux gives area needed. High flux means a small receiver with low heat loss and cost; but the higher the flux the larger the temperature gradient and thermal stress in tube walls and the easier local overheating of the fluid. Peak flux on molten-salt receivers is usually held near a megawatt per square metre with the mean about half the peak. Liquid sodium conducts far better and takes over twice the flux; steam and air much less. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：熔鹽吸熱器的尖峰通量約 1 MW/m²
steps.observationEn: Project file: Peak flux on a molten-salt receiver is about 1 MW/m²
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「吸熱器做得越小越集中，效率就越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The smaller and more concentrated a receiver, the more efficient it is." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「吸熱面積與平均通量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Receiver area and mean flux”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吸熱面積與平均通量
knowledge.text: 吸熱器要做多大？它必須吸收的熱功率是由鏡場決定的；除以表面的平均通量，就得到所需的面積。通量取得高，吸熱器小、熱損少、成本低；但通量越高，管壁的溫度梯度與熱應力越大，管內的流體也越容易局部過熱。熔鹽吸熱器的尖峰通量通常限制在每平方公尺一千瓩上下，平均值約為尖峰的一半。液態鈉的導熱好得多，可以承受兩倍以上的通量；水蒸汽與空氣則差得多。
knowledge.textEn: How large should a receiver be? Thermal power it must absorb is set by the field, and dividing by mean surface flux gives area needed. High flux means a small receiver with low heat loss and cost; but the higher the flux the larger the temperature gradient and thermal stress in tube walls and the easier local overheating of the fluid. Peak flux on molten-salt receivers is usually held near a megawatt per square metre with the mean about half the peak. Liquid sodium conducts far better and takes over twice the flux; steam and air much less.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：吸熱器做得越小越集中，效率就越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The smaller and more concentrated a receiver, the more efficient it is. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.text: 熔鹽吸熱器的尖峰通量約 1 MW/m²

quiz.question: 依「吸熱面積與平均通量」的模型 A = Q / q，熱功率 565 MW、平均通量 0.5 MW/m² 時所需的吸熱面積最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model A = Q / q for "Receiver area and mean flux", which value is closest to the receiver area for 565 MW thermal at a mean flux of 0.5 MW/m²?
options: 565 m²
optionsEn: 565 m²
quiz.explanation: A = Q / q；代入 Q = 565 MW、q = 0.5 MW/m²，得 1,130 m²（熱功率 565 MW、平均通量 0.5 MW/m² 時所需的吸熱面積）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: A = Q / q; with Q = 565 MW, q = 0.5 MW/m² the result is 1,130 m² (receiver area for 565 MW thermal at a mean flux of 0.5 MW/m²). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 吸熱面積與平均通量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Receiver area and mean flux: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吸熱面積與平均通量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Receiver area and mean flux” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：A = Q / q；代入 Q = 565 MW、q = 0.5 MW/m²，得 1,130 m²（熱功率 565 MW、平均通量 0.5 MW/m² 時所需的吸熱面積）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 q 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A = Q / q; with Q = 565 MW, q = 0.5 MW/m² the result is 1,130 m² (receiver area for 565 MW thermal at a mean flux of 0.5 MW/m²). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise q by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,027 m²（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising q by 10% changes the result to 1,027 m² (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1,130 m²（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 q 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1,130 m² (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in q with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: A = Q / q；代入 Q = 565 MW、q = 0.5 MW/m²，得 1,130 m²（熱功率 565 MW、平均通量 0.5 MW/m² 時所需的吸熱面積）。
knowledge.textEn: A = Q / q; with Q = 565 MW, q = 0.5 MW/m² the result is 1,130 m² (receiver area for 565 MW thermal at a mean flux of 0.5 MW/m²).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,027 m²（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising q by 10% changes the result to 1,027 m² (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吸熱面積與平均通量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Receiver area and mean flux"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以相機拍攝吸熱器表面的反射亮度換算通量分布，並與各管排的吸熱量量測值比較。
只要出口的鹽溫沒有超過上限，管子裡就沒有問題。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Cameras image reflected brightness of the receiver surface to derive flux distribution for comparison with measured heat absorbed by each panel.
As long as outlet salt temperature is within the limit, all is well inside the tubes.
quiz.explanation: 以相機拍攝吸熱器表面的反射亮度換算通量分布，並與各管排的吸熱量量測值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cameras image reflected brightness of the receiver surface to derive flux distribution for comparison with measured heat absorbed by each panel. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吸熱面積與平均通量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Receiver area and mean flux: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吸熱面積與平均通量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Receiver area and mean flux” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以相機拍攝吸熱器表面的反射亮度換算通量分布，並與各管排的吸熱量量測值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cameras image reflected brightness of the receiver surface to derive flux distribution for comparison with measured heat absorbed by each panel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吸熱器要與鏡場的瞄準策略一起設計，以多個瞄準點把通量攤平在容許值以下。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design receiver and field aiming strategy together, flattening flux below allowable with multiple aim points.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：瞄準策略把所有定日鏡都對準吸熱器的中心時，中央的尖峰通量遠高於容許值，管子在幾分鐘內過熱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An aiming strategy pointing every heliostat at receiver centre puts central peak flux far above allowable and overheats tubes within minutes. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以相機拍攝吸熱器表面的反射亮度換算通量分布，並與各管排的吸熱量量測值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Cameras image reflected brightness of the receiver surface to derive flux distribution for comparison with measured heat absorbed by each panel.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吸熱器要與鏡場的瞄準策略一起設計，以多個瞄準點把通量攤平在容許值以下。
knowledge.textEn: Design receiver and field aiming strategy together, flattening flux below allowable with multiple aim points.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：SolarPACES 定日鏡與反射鏡量測指引。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: SolarPACES guidelines for heliostat and reflectance measurement. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「吸熱面積與平均通量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Receiver area and mean flux" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
吸熱器把照到它的陽光全部變成了熱。
瞄準策略把所有定日鏡都對準吸熱器的中心時，中央的尖峰通量遠高於容許值，管子在幾分鐘內過熱。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A receiver turns all sunlight striking it into heat.
An aiming strategy pointing every heliostat at receiver centre puts central peak flux far above allowable and overheats tubes within minutes.
quiz.explanation: 瞄準策略把所有定日鏡都對準吸熱器的中心時，中央的尖峰通量遠高於容許值，管子在幾分鐘內過熱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An aiming strategy pointing every heliostat at receiver centre puts central peak flux far above allowable and overheats tubes within minutes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 吸熱面積與平均通量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Receiver area and mean flux: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吸熱面積與平均通量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Receiver area and mean flux” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 瞄準策略把所有定日鏡都對準吸熱器的中心時，中央的尖峰通量遠高於容許值，管子在幾分鐘內過熱。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「太陽能熱發電吸熱器設計」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: An aiming strategy pointing every heliostat at receiver centre puts central peak flux far above allowable and overheats tubes within minutes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Solar Thermal Receiver Design”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：液態鈉的導熱好得多，可以承受兩倍以上的通量；水蒸汽與空氣則差得多。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Liquid sodium conducts far better and takes over twice the flux; steam and air much less.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「吸熱器做得越小越集中，效率就越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The smaller and more concentrated a receiver, the more efficient it is." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 瞄準策略把所有定日鏡都對準吸熱器的中心時，中央的尖峰通量遠高於容許值，管子在幾分鐘內過熱。
knowledge.textEn: An aiming strategy pointing every heliostat at receiver centre puts central peak flux far above allowable and overheats tubes within minutes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
